stem: One cultivar appears slower to recover after canopy work, but it was at a different flowering stage than the comparison group. What is the best conclusion?
choices: The cultivar is proven genetically intolerant.
The slower group should be removed from the record.
Stage is a confounder, so genotype causation is not established from this comparison.
rationale: Stage is a confounder, so genotype causation is not established from this comparison.
